faults.label: the stored column is not the squares of anything
faults.new: (sum(abs(code) for code in codes[at : at + dim])
faults.old: (sum(code * code for code in codes[at : at + dim])

faults.label: the reader stops checking which codes the column names
the derived column is read around the digest predicate
the reader ignores the stored column and always computes
a declared artifact is read on the manifest's word again

why: The embedding gate proves the vectors are attributed, aligned and non-degenerate, and that the stored row-squares column is the column it claims to be. A stored derived column is a new way to be wrong in the worst shape -- right length, right dtype, every value wrong -- so each of its fallbacks is injected here rather than assumed.
